in_latin.name: Desmond
in_latin.meaning: Desmond means from Desmond region in Ireland
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Desmond originates from the region of Desmond in Ireland, which was a kingdom in the 12th century. The name itself is derived from the Irish Gaelic 'Deas-mumhan,' meaning 'free from envy' or 'world' and 'region.'
